_comment: B2 spec/eval pilot (decisions/0011, UD1). Scoped to the three pure pilot functions ONLY -- validateSecurityTxt, validateLlmsTxt, validateFeedJson (175 LOC total). The rest of each mutated file (main(), checkPresence, validateFeedXml -- all network-path plumbing or explicitly out of pilot scope) is bracketed with '// Stryker disable all' / '// Stryker restore all' comments so it is never mutated in the first place, rather than mutated-and-ignored via a NoCoverage carve-out. This is what makes the mutation gate carry the pilot's sufficiency claim (§2 DR2) rather than being diluted by untested network code. thresholds.break=70 is the measured floor (72.31% observed across repeated runs on 2026-07-29), with a small buffer for one borderline UpdateOperator infinite-loop mutant near the vitest per-test timeout. Known, accepted survivors: ~22 StringLiteral mutants on message text (never asserted -- only {id, severity} pairs are part of the spec contract); ~28 Regex mutants on boundary variants the declared case set does not discriminate; a handful that used to sit on validate-llms-txt.mjs's currentSection.isOptional (assigned, never read, so an equivalent mutant no test could ever kill) are gone -- the field was dropped when the structural core moved to lib/llms-structure.mjs. That move is why lib/llms-structure.mjs is in `mutate` below: validateLlmsTxt is now a catalog wrapper that maps the shared reference's {id, message} through emit(), so the structural mutants live in the reference and the gate must follow them there or it silently loses its teeth. Raise thresholds.break as cases are added; do not lower it to make a regression pass.
_comment_plugins: REQUIRED under pnpm (atlas decision 0032). Stryker's default plugin discovery globs `@stryker-mutator/*` under the node_modules that contains @stryker-mutator/core -- under npm's flat tree that is the project root, where the vitest runner also sits, so discovery worked implicitly. pnpm's isolated layout puts core under node_modules/.pnpm/@stryker-mutator+core@<hash>/node_modules/, whose sibling @stryker-mutator/ directory holds only core's own deps, so the glob finds nothing and the run dies with 'Cannot find TestRunner plugin "vitest". In fact, no TestRunner plugins were loaded.' Naming the plugin explicitly resolves it from the project root instead of by glob. Do not remove.
